scope: development target < 2026-06-01. No holdout labels or scores read. 0 API calls. Submission unchanged.
folds: lab/folds.json, 40 training symbols, 50 evaluation symbols, src.data.score

logistic.preprocessing: train-only median impute, train-only standardisation, missing indicator per feature

p1.rewrite: up -> 3, down -> 1, only when B0 points elsewhere, flat B0 rows included
p1.gate: fold-wise on/off by the existing inner 3-block 12-day-embargo mean gain; ties off

t1.novelty: symbol-day title bundle, 1 - max TF-IDF cosine to the previous 20 trading-day documents, IDF on prior documents only
t1.high_rule: 80% quantile of the same symbol's strictly earlier novelty; held when fewer than 20 prior observed days

adoption.bootstrap: 5-trading-day blocks of 50-symbol days, 2000 draws, seed 2026, 2.5% quantile > 0 (family of 2)

T1.action: terminated; novelty definition, window and prompt were not re-tuned

limitation: these are repeatedly inspected development results; no holdout evidence either way
